quick_start.recommended_input: Begin with one adult bookbinder tying a cobalt scarf inside a quiet workshop. Follow the subject inside the tram as city walls give way to an open river route. A clean gust lifts the scarf end as the subject opens a finished notebook and holds the calm arrival.
